## About
Automotion sits on Excelsior Blvd in St. Louis Park. One reviewer drove past it at the France and Excelsior stoplight for years thinking it was just a gas station, then stopped in for fuel and found a shop that knows BMWs and Mercedes inside and out.
Our passion is European cars. We work on everything from regular maintenance to the most complicated diagnostics, and we use quality parts through our relationships with local European parts suppliers. Before you head to the dealership, give us a try.
Neighbors rate us 4.8 from 57 reviews on Google, and they keep coming back because we tell them what their car really needs.

## Services
- European car repair: Repair work from a shop built around a passion for European cars.
- Diagnostics: From routine checkups to the most complicated diagnostic work.
- Full synthetic oil change: Keep your car running well with a full synthetic oil change.
- Fuel and convenience: Fill up and grab what you need while you are here.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in European cars, including Mercedes-Benz, Audi, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche, Aston Martin, Land Rover and Volvo.

Q: Is there a place to wait while my car is serviced?
A: Yes. We have a comfortable waiting area with free wi-fi.

Q: Can I see my car's service history?
A: Yes. Our software gives you access to your service history and maintenance requirements so you can plan ahead.
